sheet.title: Set the diamond
sheet.instruction: Lay a thin square face up with one corner toward you. Keep this corner nearest you while you work.
sheet.result: The four points mark the top, bottom, left and right of the boat pattern.

mark-first-diagonal.title: Mark the first diagonal
mark-first-diagonal.instruction: Bring the top point down to the bottom point. Press across the whole width.
mark-first-diagonal.result: A triangle rests below the horizontal crease.

reopen-first-diagonal.title: Reopen the sheet · First diagonal
reopen-first-diagonal.instruction: Lift the folded half and return it to its original position.
reopen-first-diagonal.result: The square lies flat with the diagonal still visible.

mark-second-diagonal.title: Mark the second diagonal
mark-second-diagonal.instruction: Bring the left point over to the right point and press the fold.
mark-second-diagonal.result: The new crease crosses the first at the center.

reopen-second-diagonal.title: Reopen the sheet · Second diagonal
reopen-second-diagonal.instruction: Lift the folded half and return it to its original position.
reopen-second-diagonal.result: The square lies flat with the diagonal still visible.

blintz-north.title: Bring the point to the center · Top
blintz-north.instruction: Take just the named corner to the crossing of the diagonals. Press the crease halfway between the corner and center.
blintz-north.result: The point lies at the center above the underlying sheet.

blintz-south.title: Bring the point to the center · Bottom
blintz-south.instruction: Take just the named corner to the crossing of the diagonals. Press the crease halfway between the corner and center.
blintz-south.result: The point lies at the center above the underlying sheet.

blintz-west.title: Bring the point to the center · Left
blintz-west.instruction: Take just the named corner to the crossing of the diagonals. Press the crease halfway between the corner and center.
blintz-west.result: The point lies at the center above the underlying sheet.

blintz-east.title: Bring the point to the center · Right
blintz-east.instruction: Take just the named corner to the crossing of the diagonals. Press the crease halfway between the corner and center.
blintz-east.result: The point lies at the center above the underlying sheet.

close-left-gate.title: Close the gate · Left
close-left-gate.instruction: Fold the named doubled edge inward until it meets the middle line. Keep all the layers of that margin together.
close-left-gate.result: A narrow flap covers half of the central strip.

close-right-gate.title: Close the gate · Right
close-right-gate.instruction: Fold the named doubled edge inward until it meets the middle line. Keep all the layers of that margin together.
close-right-gate.result: A narrow flap covers half of the central strip.

double-the-rectangle.title: Double the rectangle
double-the-rectangle.instruction: Fold the lower half behind the upper half along the middle crosswise crease.
double-the-rectangle.result: The two short ends coincide in a smaller packet.

mark-front-quarter.title: Mark the front quarter
mark-front-quarter.instruction: On the front only, bring the far edge down to the doubled edge.
mark-front-quarter.result: A crosswise crease divides the front half.

mark-back-quarter.title: Mark the back quarter
mark-back-quarter.instruction: Reach behind and fold the far edge of the back packet away to meet the doubled edge.
mark-back-quarter.result: The same quarter mark now exists on the back layers.

release-back-quarter.title: Release the quarter fold · Back
release-back-quarter.instruction: Unfold the named packet along the crosswise mark without disturbing the other layers.
release-back-quarter.result: Its far edge returns to the top of the doubled rectangle.

release-front-quarter.title: Release the quarter fold · Front
release-front-quarter.instruction: Unfold the named packet along the crosswise mark without disturbing the other layers.
release-front-quarter.result: Its far edge returns to the top of the doubled rectangle.

open-the-rectangle.title: Open the rectangle
open-the-rectangle.instruction: Swing the lower packet out from behind. Leave both narrow gates folded.
open-the-rectangle.result: Two parallel quarter marks cross the long rectangle.

open-right-gate.title: Open the gate · Right
open-right-gate.instruction: Lift the named edge of the center seam and swing the whole gate out on its existing crease.
open-right-gate.result: The corner underneath is exposed on that side.

open-left-gate.title: Open the gate · Left
open-left-gate.instruction: Lift the named edge of the center seam and swing the whole gate out on its existing crease.
open-left-gate.result: The corner underneath is exposed on that side.

draw-out-north-point.title: Draw out the point · Top
draw-out-north-point.instruction: Lift the named triangle by its loose tip at the center and swing it outward on the old corner crease.
draw-out-north-point.result: A full point now extends beyond the packet.

draw-out-south-point.title: Draw out the point · Bottom
draw-out-south-point.instruction: Lift the named triangle by its loose tip at the center and swing it outward on the old corner crease.
draw-out-south-point.result: A full point now extends beyond the packet.

wrap-left-rail.title: Rewrap the rail · Left
wrap-left-rail.instruction: Fold the named long margin back to the center line, keeping the two projecting points outside.
wrap-left-rail.result: The folded margin makes a doubled rail beside the center seam.

wrap-right-rail.title: Rewrap the rail · Right
wrap-right-rail.instruction: Fold the named long margin back to the center line, keeping the two projecting points outside.
wrap-right-rail.result: The folded margin makes a doubled rail beside the center seam.

face-the-bow.title: Fold the end facing · Bow
face-the-bow.instruction: Fold the projecting tip inward across the indicated crosswise line, about one third of the way in from the point to the center.
face-the-bow.result: The broad folded edge will form a seat back. Its free tip faces the middle.

face-the-stern.title: Fold the end facing · Stern
face-the-stern.instruction: Fold the projecting tip inward across the indicated crosswise line, about one third of the way in from the point to the center.
face-the-stern.result: The broad folded edge will form a seat back. Its free tip faces the middle.

open-the-hull.title: Raise the hull
open-the-hull.instruction: Hold the narrow rectangular floor. Lift both rails and both ends together, pinching the four diagonal corner creases upward as the walls rise.
open-the-hull.result: Four closed corners surround a recessed floor. The end backs rise above the rails.

bow-seat.title: Level the seat · Bow
bow-seat.instruction: At the named end, lift only the short free tongue toward the middle until it sits parallel to the floor.
bow-seat.result: A small horizontal seat projects from the inside of the raised back.

stern-seat.title: Level the seat · Stern
stern-seat.instruction: At the named end, lift only the short free tongue toward the middle until it sits parallel to the floor.
stern-seat.result: A small horizontal seat projects from the inside of the raised back.
